item.title: Georgia
item.description: The largest archive of material relating to Georgia Jewish history is at the Cuba Family Archives for Southern Jewish History at the William Breman Jewish Heritage Museum in Atlanta. In addition to a wealth of documents relating to Atlanta Jewish history, the Breman has been actively collecting archival material from around Georgia and Alabama. Click below to see the archive's Guide to Manuscript Collections.

item.title: Tennessee
item.description: Most of the major Jewish communities in Tennessee maintain significant historical archives. In Memphis, Temple Israel maintains an archive with documents from the state's oldest congregation as well as information about the Memphis Jewish community. In Nashville, The Annette Levy Ratkin Jewish Community Archives are housed in the library at the Gordon Jewish Community Center.
